label: positive

blockers.detail: the harness asserts j1 == j2 after a CBOR round trip; since M a NaN encoded in the input is decoded into a NaN value instead of null, and NaN != NaN, so the harness's own assertion aborts on any input carrying a non-finite float

evidence: M (2017-03-12) changes how non-finite floating-point values are taken from the input: before M every NaN/Inf became null when the value was built, after M it is stored as-is (and serialized as null only by dump())

maintainer fix b026591e (2017-03-14, ':ambulance: added special case to fuzzers to fix #504') replaces assert(j1 == j2) with assert(json::to_cbor(j2) == vec2); the harness at H also uses exception classes introduced between M and H, so the fix is applied as the maintainer's own hunk ported onto the harness at M (verification/counterfactual_fix.diff holds that port); the MessagePack harness was fixed the same way in f547679d
reproducer: verification/trigger_inputs/trigger_V3-46_cbor_half_nan.bin = F9 7E 00 (CBOR half-precision NaN): passes at M^1, aborts at M on the harness assertion (fuzzer-parse_cbor.cpp:45)
rationale_zh: 本次提交改变了输入编码中非有限浮点数的解码方式：此前 CBOR / MessagePack 输入里的 NaN、Inf 在构造值时一律被替换成 null；本次起按原样保存为 NaN/Inf（仅在 dump() 输出时写成 null）。CBOR harness 的往返检查写的是 assert(j1 == j2)：同一份输入解码出的值，经 to_cbor 再 from_cbor 后要求相等。现在任何带 NaN 编码的输入（如 3 字节的半精度 NaN F9 7E 00）都会解码出 NaN，而 NaN != NaN，harness 自己的断言立即 abort，栈顶就在 harness 的 LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput（fuzzer-parse_cbor.cpp:45）；同一输入在 M^1 上解码为 null，断言通过。M^1 不失败，失败由本次引入，属于显式 input_format 阳性（输入编码的解码语义变化触发 harness 侧断言）。维护者两天后在 b026591e 把断言改为比较再次序列化的结果。注：该变化也可看作 basic_json 值语义（api）的变化；这里按“输入中 NaN 编码的解码方式变化”归为 input_format。
rationale_en: This commit changes how non-finite floating-point values in the input encodings are decoded: before it, a NaN or Inf in CBOR / MessagePack input was replaced by null when the value was built; from now on it is kept as NaN/Inf (and written as null only by dump()). The CBOR harness checks its round trip with assert(j1 == j2): the value decoded from the input must equal the value decoded again after to_cbor. Now every input carrying a NaN encoding (e.g. the 3-byte half-precision NaN F9 7E 00) decodes to NaN, and since NaN != NaN the harness's own assertion aborts at once, in the harness's LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput (fuzzer-parse_cbor.cpp:45); at M^1 the same input decodes to null and the assertion holds. No failure at M^1, so it is introduced by this change: an explicit input_format positive (a change in how an input encoding is decoded trips a harness-side assertion). The maintainers changed the assertion two days later (b026591e) to compare the re-serialized bytes. Note: the change can also be read as a change of basic_json value semantics (api); it is classified here as input_format because what changed is how a NaN encoding in the input is decoded.
